subject: Darmanitan
whyItWorks: One trigger drives the whole story: half HP. The hook is four words: "Hurt it. It transforms."
The change is shown as data building tension toward the threshold: 100 → 75 → 51 → 50.
Two-stage payoff: the type changes, then the stats flip, and the second surprise is bigger.
The closing question puts the viewer in the battle decision: would you risk half your HP?

episode.title: The Pokémon That Changes When Its HP Hits Half
episode.premise: Darmanitan can transform in battle when its HP falls to half or less.
episode.audiencePromise: Show the 50% HP trigger, the type change, and the dramatic stat swap of Zen Mode.
episode.openLoop: What happens to Pokémon #555 when its HP drops to half?
episode.payoff: Zen Mode turns Darmanitan from pure Fire into Fire/Psychic and completely reshapes its battle stats.
episode.engagementQuestion: Would you risk dropping below half HP to trigger Zen Mode?

scenes.headline: HURT IT. IT TRANSFORMS.
scenes.narration: This Pokémon transforms when its health drops to half.
scenes.caption: 50% HP = TRANSFORMATION

scenes.headline: PURE FIRE. FULL POWER.
scenes.narration: Darmanitan, number five fifty-five, normally fights as pure Fire.
scenes.caption: STANDARD MODE • FIRE

scenes.narration: Its Hidden Ability, Zen Mode, triggers at half HP.
scenes.caption: THE TRIGGER IS 50%

scenes.headline: FIRE BECOMES FIRE + PSYCHIC
scenes.narration: It turns blue and becomes Fire and Psychic.
scenes.caption: FIRE → FIRE + PSYCHIC

scenes.headline: ITS STATS FLIP TOO
scenes.narration: Attack crashes, while Special Attack and both defenses surge.
scenes.caption: 140 ATTACK → 140 SPECIAL ATTACK

scenes.headline: WOULD YOU TRIGGER IT?
scenes.narration: Would you risk half your HP for Zen Mode?
scenes.caption: RISK IT FOR ZEN MODE?
